'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Bombing of Zaporizhzhia (2022–present)|Bombing of Zaporizhzhia]]
****At least two people are killed and seven others are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[missile]] strike on a residential area in [[Zaporizhzhia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-dead-after-russian-attack-ukraines-zaporizhzhia-zelenskiy-says-2023-08-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[North Korea]]n [[Supreme Leader (North Korean title)|Supreme Leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] appoints [[Chasu|Vice Marshal]] [[Ri Yong-gil]] to replace [[Jiang (rank)|General]] [[Park Su-il]] as the chief of the [[General Staff Department of the Korean People's Army]], and calls for enhancing war preparations, including increased [[Defense industry of North Korea|weapons production]] and more [[Military exercise|drills]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2352611/world (AFP via ''Arab News'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
**Parts of western and upcountry [[Maui]] island in [[Hawaii]], [[United States]], are evacuated as [[wildfire]]s fueled by [[2023 Pacific hurricane season#Hurricane Dora|Hurricane Dora]] causes power outages and disruption to [[emergency service|emergency services]] in western Maui and other parts of Hawaii including [[Oahu]] and the [[Hawaii (island)|Big Island]], with at least six people being killed. [https://apnews.com/article/hawaii-wildfire-maui-dora-winds-ec23c16abfbeb6ba689f1a98263720db (AP)]
**A large part of the [[Lahaina Historic District|historic Lahaina]] town, including the [[Waiola Church]] and the [[Honpa Hongwanji Mission of Hawaii|Lahaina Hongwanji Mission Temple]], is destroyed by the wildfires. [https://www.nbcnews.com/video/video-shows-flames-engulfing-storefronts-in-maui-town-of-lahaina-190449733718 (NBC News)] [https://www.mauinews.com/news/local-news/2023/08/maui-on-fire/ (Maui News)]
*[[2023 Tunisia migrant boat disasters]]
**Forty-one people are killed when a boat carrying 45 migrants from [[Sfax]], [[Tunisia]], [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|capsizes and sinks]] in the [[Mediterranean Sea]] off the coast of [[Lampedusa]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66448987 (BBC News)]
*[[Storm Hans]]
**After several days of heavy rain in [[Norway]], a [[dam]] collapses into the [[Glomma]] river in [[Braskereidfoss]]. Locals are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]]. [https://www.nrk.no/innlandet/vann-trenger-inn-i-kraftverk-pa-braskereidfoss-1.16510149 (NRK)]
*At least 27 people are found dead in the western desert of [[Libya]] near the [[Libya–Tunisia border|border]] with [[Tunisia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/libya-migrants-deaths-desert-tunisia-d1030c82521aa6c32095f9098c0f9f35 (AP)]
*Eleven people are killed in a fire at a [[guesthouse]] accommodating disabled people in [[Wintzenheim]], [[Alsace]], [[France]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/france/article/2023/08/09/eleven-missing-in-france-holiday-center-fire_6086307_7.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
*One person is killed and more than 50 others are injured in an explosion at the [[Zagorsk Optical-Mechanical Plant]] in [[Sergiyev Posad]], [[Moscow Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66450525 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] classifies the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant#EG.5 and EG.5.1|EG.5 variant]] of [[COVID-19]] as a [[variant of interest]]. The variant has been spreading rapidly in the [[United States]]. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/08/10/23/who-identifies-new-coronavirus-variant-of-interest (DW via ABS-CBN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Global Affairs Canada]] announces new sanctions against [[Belarus]] on the three-year anniversary of the [[2020 Belarusian presidential election]]. [https://globalnews.ca/news/9886023/belarus-canada-sanctions-election/amp/ (Global News)]

*A man in [[Provo, Utah|Provo]], [[Utah]], United States, who made threats against [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] is shot and killed by [[FBI]] agents. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/08/11/world/americas-emea/man-who-threatened-biden-shot-dead/1904857 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
